text: DSH Notebooks 是面向 Web 客户端的持久笔记插件，可跨会话保存手写内容、网页和文本来源。它在 DSH 中提供随手记工作区、模型工具及笔记引用入口，支持搜索筛选、选择来源并生成摘要、Mermaid 思维导图和 Markdown 报告。适合整理研究资料并在后续对话中引用笔记；网页来源通过 Jina Reader 读取，笔记使用本机 SQLite 保存。

DSH Notebooks is a Web plugin for saving text and web notes. It adds a searchable workspace, model tools, and @ citations. Users can select sources, generate summaries, and create mind maps or Markdown reports. Citations add note context to chat. Web pages use Jina Reader; notes use local SQLite.
我想把网页和零散文字存成长期笔记，之后还能在 DSH 里搜索。
能不能把几篇资料整理成摘要，留到下次会话继续问？
想在 DSH 侧边栏打开一个可管理来源和摘要的笔记工作区。
我想在聊天里引用以前保存的笔记，让当前问题带上那段上下文。
How can I keep web articles and text notes available across chat sessions?
I want DSH to summarize selected sources and make a mind map or report.
Can I cite a saved notebook in a chat and bring its context into that turn?
I need a searchable workspace for notes assembled from URLs and text documents.
DSH Notebooks 的功能「资料笔记」：可创建或更新持久笔记，并把手写内容、网页链接或文本资料作为来源；来源变化后会使旧摘要失效并重新触发总结。
DSH Notebooks 的功能「来源摘要」：为笔记选择参与处理的来源后，可生成面向后续追问的摘要，并在来源变更时重新总结。
DSH Notebooks 的功能「Studio 产物」：从选定笔记来源生成 Mermaid 思维导图或 Markdown 报告，并把产物保存在笔记中。
DSH Notebooks 的功能「聊天引用」：通过输入框的 @ 选择一篇笔记；插件把该笔记的摘要与来源信息附加到本轮用户消息上下文。

@deepseek-ai/dsh-notebooks README · 📓 Notebooks：[English](README.en.md) | 中文

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-notebooks` 把 Codemini 风格的持久随手记带到 DSH。它提供 SQLite 存储、模型工具、生成的 `notebooks` Remote namespace，以及侧栏打开的全局「随手记」工作区。

@deepseek-ai/dsh-notebooks README · ✨ 特性：- 🗂️ 在 `#notes` 资料库中用网格或列表浏览支持搜索、筛选和排序的笔记。
- 📝 创建混合来源笔记：手写内容、网页链接、TXT/Markdown 文档。
- 🌐 自动抓取未读网页，来源变更后清空总结和 Studio 产物并重新总结。
- ✅ 精确选择参与综合总结和 Studio 产物的来源。
- 🧠 由宿主私有 Agent 生成综合总结、Mermaid 思维导图和 Markdown 报告。
- 💬 对话输入框用笔记本图标打开弹出框，或 `@` 引用**一篇**笔记追问；消息气泡下显示可点击的笔记徽章并跳转到 `#notes/<id>`。
- 🗑️ 删除前确认；工作区可查看来源原文并跳转原链接。

@deepseek-ai/dsh-notebooks README · 🚀 快速开始：安装插件：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:havingautism/dsh-notebooks
dsh web
```

在左侧边栏底部打开「随手记」，或访问 `#notes` / `#notes/<id>`。插件 patch 启用 generation runner。启动时若宿主还没有 sqlite / HTTP fetch，会自行挂上；已经有了则共用。笔记和深度研究共用一份 sqlite（默认 `~/.dsh/storages/dsh.sqlite`），各自占用独立 domain（`notebooks` / `deepresearch`）。首次启动会把旧的 `notebooks.sqlite` 迁进这份库。单独安装即可使用，不必先装深度研究或手写 yml。不要再 YAML `insert` 一遍 `storage-sqlite`。

@deepseek-ai/dsh-notebooks README · 网页抓取与安全：DSH 默认 **不启用** 聊天里的 `web_fetch` 工具，也不挂载 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-fetch-http`（见 [dsh-base `cordis.patch.yml`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/bundle/base/cordis.patch.yml#L396-L418) 与 [Web 默认搜索决策说明](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/.agents/notes/implemented/feature/2026-07-31-web-default-search.zh.md)）。原因是模型自选 URL 抓取存在 SSRF 等风险。

@deepseek-ai/dsh-notebooks README · 网页抓取与安全：随手记抓取网页来源时 **优先走 Jina Reader**（`https://r.jina.ai/...`）。失败或正文为空时再回退到 `ctx.web.fetch`；若当时还没有 HTTP fetch provider，插件会自行挂上 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-fetch-http`。已挂过则跳过，因此和 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-deepresearch` 同时安装不会抢同一个 loader id。聊天里的 `web_fetch` 仍然保持关闭。

安装或使用网页抓取能力即表示你接受：宿主可对公网 URL 发起 HTTP(S) 请求；provider 有 URL 校验与体积/超时限制，但不能消除所有 SSRF 场景。请在可信环境使用。

@deepseek-ai/dsh-notebooks README · What the model sees：模型会看到 `notebook_list`、`notebook_write`、`notebook_add_source`、`notebook_set_summary`、`notebook_set_artifact`、`notebook_save_chat_answer` 和 `notebook_delete`。普通聊天不会为选中的笔记改写系统提示；`@` 引用只在该轮用户消息旁注入 recall 上下文。
@deepseek-ai/dsh-notebooks README · Token effect：工具可见时承担固定 schema 成本；结果成本与配置上限内匹配的总结和正文量成正比。追问注入只增加当前轮的笔记摘要。
@deepseek-ai/dsh-notebooks README · KV Cache 影响：静态 schema 会扩展请求头。已保存内容只通过工具结果或该轮 recall 注入进入请求，因此持久数据变更不会重写已有请求前缀。

@deepseek-ai/dsh-notebooks README · 已知限制与后续工作：- 浏览器上传当前只提取 UTF-8 纯文本和 Markdown。PDF、DOCX 需要组合附件提取器，不会用有损的浏览器文本解码来假装支持。
- 对话气泡没有「保存到随手记」插槽；保存聊天回答走 Remote / `notebook_save_chat_answer` 工具。
- 运行中的私有生成 Agent 会随宿主进程停止；笔记本身保持持久化，但不会自动续跑中断的总结或 Studio 任务。
- 搜索采用有界的内存子串与精确标签匹配，不提供排序型全文检索。

@deepseek-ai/dsh-notebooks README · 📓 Notebooks：English | [中文](README.md)

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-notebooks` brings Codemini-style durable notebooks to DSH. It provides SQLite storage, model tools, the generated `notebooks` Remote namespace, and a sidebar-launched global `随手记` workspace.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-notebooks README · ✨ Features：- 🗂️ Browse a searchable, filterable library at `#notes` in grid or list mode.
- 📝 Create mixed-source notes from handwritten text, web links, and TXT/Markdown documents.
- 🌐 Fetch unread URLs automatically; source changes clear the overview and Studio artifacts and retrigger summarization.
- ✅ Select the exact sources used for an overview or Studio output.
- 🧠 Let a private host Agent generate overviews, Mermaid mind maps, and Markdown reports.
- 💬 Cite **one** notebook from the composer with `@` or the **Notebooks picker**; that turn receives `<notebook_context>`, and a clickable notebook badge under the user bubble opens `#notes/<id>`.
- 🗑️ Confirm before delete; inspect source originals and jump to the original URL.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-notebooks README · 🚀 Quick Start：Install this bundle by itself:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:havingautism/dsh-notebooks
dsh web
```

@deepseek-ai/dsh-notebooks README · 🚀 Quick Start：Open `随手记` from the sidebar footer, or visit `#notes` / `#notes/<id>`. The patch enables the generation runner. At boot, if the host has no sqlite / HTTP fetch yet, this plugin mounts them; if they already exist, it reuses them. Notebooks and Deep Research share one sqlite file (default `~/.dsh/storages/dsh.sqlite`) with separate domains (`notebooks` / `deepresearch`). A leftover `notebooks.sqlite` is imported on first launch. A notebooks-only install is enough — you do not need Deep Research or a hand-written yml. Do not YAML-`insert` `storage-sqlite` again.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-notebooks README · Web fetch and security：DSH ships with chat `web_fetch` disabled and without `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-fetch-http` mounted (see [dsh-base `cordis.patch.yml`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/bundle/base/cordis.patch.yml#L396-L418) and the [default Web search decision note](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/.agents/notes/implemented/feature/2026-07-31-web-default-search.md)). Model-selected URL retrieval carries SSRF-style risk.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-notebooks README · Web fetch and security：Notebooks fetches URL sources **through Jina Reader first** (`https://r.jina.ai/...`). It falls back to `ctx.web.fetch` when Jina fails or returns an empty body, and mounts `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-fetch-http` itself when that provider is missing. An already-mounted provider is left alone, so installing alongside `@deepseek-ai/dsh-deepresearch` does not duplicate loader ids. Chat `web_fetch` stays off.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-notebooks README · Web fetch and security：Using web fetch means the host may request public HTTP(S) URLs. The provider applies URL, size, and timeout limits but does not remove every SSRF scenario. Use in a trusted environment.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-notebooks README · What the model sees：The model sees `notebook_list`, `notebook_write`, `notebook_add_source`, `notebook_set_summary`, `notebook_set_artifact`, `notebook_save_chat_answer`, and `notebook_delete`. Ordinary chat does not rewrite the system prompt for a selected note; an `@` citation injects recall context beside that turn's user message.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-notebooks README · Token effect：Fixed schema cost applies while the tools are visible. Result cost is proportional to matching summaries and content within configured limits. Follow-up injection adds only the current turn's notebook overview.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-notebooks README · KV Cache effect：The static schemas extend the request header. Stored notebook content enters a request only through Tool results or that turn's recall injection, so durable mutations do not rewrite an existing request prefix.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-notebooks README · Known Limitations and Deferred Work：- Browser upload currently extracts UTF-8 plain-text and Markdown files. PDF and DOCX extraction requires a composed attachment extractor and is not simulated with lossy browser text decoding.
- Conversation message bubbles have no “save to notebooks” slot. Saving a chat answer uses the Remote API or the `notebook_save_chat_answer` tool.
- Private generation Agents stop with the host process. Notes stay durable, but interrupted summary or Studio jobs are not resumed automatically.
- Search uses bounded in-memory substring and exact-tag matching rather than ranked full-text retrieval.
